{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiRegressionInvitation/FxUiRegressionInvitationShine.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Streets, buildings, bricks and rubble...', 5: '3'}
{1: "Before you is a world you've heard so much about, yet never truly experienced."}

{1: 'The streets are narrow and cramped, yet an unfamiliar warmth fills the air. However, that warmth does not come from the sunlight, no—it comes from something far richer, the essence of life itself.'}
{1: 'Pedestrians stroll along, casually discarding what would be considered precious commodities back in the real world.', 5: '1'}
{1: 'If it was back home, these resources would need to be carefully rationed and allocated.', 7: '1'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiRegressionInvitation/FxUiRegressionInvitationShine.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Female Student by the Road A', 3: 'This Mega Yummy Super Cutie-Q milk tea is so good!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Female Student by the Road B', 3: "Right? Let's go get some crepes too, yeah?", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Female Student by the Road A', 3: "What flavor should we get? Strawberry, banana, or chocolate... Y'know what, let's just get all of them!", 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1030.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{3: "The girls' laughter fades into the distance. You stand there, eyes lingering on the milk tea cups they've carelessly tossed into the trash."}
{2: 'Just what is this place...?', 3: '27'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'A world much like your own, yet entirely different.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Kurumi takes a few steps forward, her shadow stretching long beneath the setting sun.'}

{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "The Punishing Virus... If I recall correctly, that's what visitors from your world call the calamity that befell Earth. Here, however, no such disaster ever took place.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Life here is peaceful, and people have everything they need. They study, grow up, enter society, and once it\'s the "right time," they would get married and have children...', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1181.jpg'}
{3: "Crowds of people come and go along the crosswalk. It doesn't take long before you lose sight of Kurumi among them."}
{2: 'Tokisaki?', 3: '55', 4: '(Search for Kurumi)', 5: '55'}
{1: '1', 2: "Kurumi Tokisaki's Voice", 3: 'See? In a world like this, I can vanish into the crowd in the blink of an eye.', 4: '18'}

{3: "Amidst the cacophony of crosswalk signals, Kurumi's voice drifts farther and farther away."}
{1: '1', 2: "Kurumi Tokisaki's Voice", 3: 'Take a guess. Where do you think I am right now?', 4: '18'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{2: '(Search for Kurumi in the crowd)', 3: '79', 4: '(Look at where you came from)', 5: '79'}
{1: '1', 2: "Kurumi Tokisaki's Voice", 3: 'Nope. Try again.', 4: '18'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'The crosswalk timer approaches zero, and the crowd thins. You instinctively dash toward the other side—'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Bingo. Congratulations on learning how to cross the street.', 4: '18'}
{1: 'DialogDisable'}
{3: 'The elusive girl suddenly appears behind you and gives your shoulder a light tap before skipping across to the opposite side, hands clasped behind her back.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Though I must admit... all of this feels very foreign to me.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'After all, these lives belong to "them."', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiDiceGame/FxUiDiceGameBg02.prefab', 2: '1'}
{3: "She stops at the end of the crosswalk and turns around, her black twin tails fluttering in the wind like a raven's wings."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiDiceGame/FxUiDiceGameBg02.prefab'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'What about you, 【kuroname】? How do you feel, seeing all of this?', 4: '1'}
{2: '...', 3: '109', 4: "I have so many questions I'd like to ask you...", 5: '109'}
{2: "But for now, there's just one thing I need you to answer.", 3: '110'}
{2: "Kurumi Tokisaki. I don't recall ever telling you my name. In that case, how do you know it?", 3: '111'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "There's no need to be so worried. All your questions will be answered in due time.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "I'm not telling you all this to make you doubt me or question this world.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'I just want you to understand them.', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1181.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{3: "You follow Kurumi's lead, weaving past cars parked along the asphalt, passing by vibrant storefronts. Before you know it, you've ventured into the heart of the city."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Even in a world as peaceful as this, people still have troubles, bound by things they can never have.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'And soon, you\'ll meet many people who\'ve become trapped in their own "nightmares."', 4: '1'}
{2: '...Alright.', 3: '128', 4: 'Then, tell me more about this world.', 5: '128'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "It's settled then. I will make sure you thoroughly understand this world, human.", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1377.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryBlackSmokeNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'RImgBg1BlowUp'}
{3: 'She smiles faintly, then turns and leads you deeper into a narrow alley.'}
{3: 'Even in times of peace, back alleys in any city always harbor the unsavory.'}
{3: 'The foul stench of mold festers in the damp air. Rats scurry across the floor every so often. Small wonder no one comes near this place.'}
{1: 'RImgBg1BlowUp'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryBlackSmokeNew.prefab'}

{1: '1', 3: 'Kurumi, though, pays the filth no mind, walking straight ahead. She stops before a dried bloodstain nearly the same color as the dust around it, crouches down, and shows the clue to you.'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Quite a few guests have gone missing around the commercial district lately. Judging from the traces left behind, they were dragged away by the "Nightmares."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'There should be a "door" up ahead that connects to the Deep Dream then...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'But charging in blindly, possibly into hordes of Nightmares, would be far from wise.', 3: '149'}
{3: 'You finish the sentence for her.'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Mm-hm, precisely. How about we try "memory tracing" first? While it\'s not what this ability was designed for, given the circumstances...', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiDuihualiziLoopGold.prefab', 2: '3', 5: '6'}

{1: '1', 3: "She stands up. Radiant golden light spills from her body once more, and in the blink of an eye, she's shifted into her battle form, flintlock pistol in hand."}

{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1367.jpg'}
{3: 'The bullet strikes an inconspicuous advertising sign by the street. As soon as it does, the two of you are pulled back to the shopping district from days ago.'}
{3: 'The dried bloodstain on the ground shifts from dark to fresh, from dried to viscous, before fading away completely without a trace.'}
{3: "Meanwhile, the one responsible simply blows the smoke from her flintlock's muzzle before smoothly holstering the weapon."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Looks like tragedy has yet to strike at this point.', 4: '1', 17: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Perfect for conducting our investigation, wouldn't you say?", 4: '1', 22: '1'}
{2: "...Aren't you going to explain what just happened?", 3: '199'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Now then, what is there to explain? This is a dream, and I'm merely a traveler passing through. Let's just call everything you witnessed... a little fantasy.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Think of it as a little trick that only works in the Dream Realm, if you will.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "That answer should be good enough for you too, no? You didn't come all this way just to uncover my secrets, after all.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Though, if you truly are so curious about me... Rather than boring you with words, I could always give you a first-hand experience, if you'd like?", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1034.jpg'}
{3: 'After some playful exchanges, the two of you begin tracing the path that the blood once trailed. As you pass through a brief stretch of shadow, an open plaza comes into view.'}
{1: '1', 3: "The afternoon commercial square is nearly empty, save for a few scattered pigeons and one dejected young man. He's sprawled across a bench, not minding the stares of passersby one bit."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "This person's practically overflowing with negative emotions. There's no doubt about it—he's the owner of those bloodstains.", 4: '2'}

{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Since we\'re in a "dream," time most likely flows differently here compared to the real world... In any case, let\'s see what information we can get out of him first.', 4: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1', 3: 'You nod and proceed to approach the young man.'}
{2: 'Hello, do you have a minute?', 3: '237', 4: '(Pat his back)', 5: '237'}
{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: "Wh-What do you want? Nobody told me I'm not allowed to sleep on park benches!", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The young man bolts upright, his expression filled with wariness.'}
{2: "There's no need to be so on edge.", 3: '242'}
{2: "I simply wanted to ask why you were sleeping on the streets even though we're in the Dream Realm, where any wish can come true.", 3: '243'}
{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: "Isn't it obvious? Just look around! Does this world seem normal to you?!", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: "When I first got here, everyone said I'll never have to worry about anything anymore. So long as I followed the Dream Master's orders, I'd get to live whatever life I wanted.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: 'But then, a few days passed, and I realized something super horrifying—this dream sustains itself by feeding living people to those Nightmares!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: 'I tried warning everyone, but not a single soul believed me. Not one!', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: "I confronted the Dream Master, begged her to send me back to the real world. But all she does is put on this pathetic act, saying she can't help me, that she doesn't know how to send anyone back either...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: "Bull****! That woman has complete control over this dream world. She's keeping us trapped here to rot, fattening us up as food for the Nightmares!", 4: '1'}
{3: "The young man's eyes are vacant, yet his words remain sharp and coherent. You exchange a knowing glance with Kurumi before encouraging him to continue."}
{2: "Want to team up with us, then? We're looking for a way back to the real world too.", 3: '251'}
{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: 'Huh?! You actually believe me?!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'A spark ignites in his eyes, as if the will to live has been rekindled within him.'}

{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: 'I\'ve told at least a hundred people by now, but they always just respond like some NPC. "You\'re overthinking it." "This world isn\'t that bad." "Lady Nozomi would never hurt anyone." They say...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: "I warned them that they need to be more careful, or one of these nights, they'll really get devoured by those black sludge freaks...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: 'And guess what? Just a few days later, those idiots who brushed me off started disappearing one by one!', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: 'And even then, those who remained would still keep parroting the same lines. "They didn\'t disappear." "Lady Nozomi will keep everyone safe." "You\'re just stressed and seeing things."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: "****ing dumbasses! Do they even hear themselves?! And I'M the one who lost my mind?!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'I understand how you feel, but please, calm down.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Now, while we do believe you, we'll need you to give us more information if we are to find a way out of here.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'For instance... do you remember how you ended up in this world?', 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: "The girl's words carry a strange, compelling quality that gradually soothes the young man. His tension fades as he sinks onto the bench with a heavy, defeated sigh."}

{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: "I... I can't remember. The world I came from felt so gray. Day after day, it was just work piling up, bills I couldn't pay, my boss screaming at me nonstop, my family constantly nagging...", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: "One day, I couldn't take it anymore, so I decked my boss and walked out. Didn't even bother handing in my resignation. That said, I was too ashamed to face my parents, so I decided to live in some park nearby instead.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: "And right when I'd hit rock bottom... I got an invitation to the Dream Realm...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Do you remember what this "invitation" was exactly?', 3: '277'}
{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: 'I think I was on some roof that night, and I met...', 4: '1'}
{3: 'His voice grows fainter and fainter as he mumbles.'}
{3: "The young man's eyes grow increasingly distant, and he no longer responds. He stares blankly ahead, still muttering to himself."}
{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: 'Right... who was... the person who invited me again?', 4: '1'}
{1: 'PanelActor1Shake'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryBlackSmokeNew.prefab', 2: '2', 3: '1'}
{3: 'Suddenly, his eyes go wide, pupils dilated. Wisps of black smoke begin seeping from his body.'}
{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: 'Ahahaha, I remember now! I finally remember!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: 'Why should I take any of this? I came here to get back at the people who pushed me to the edge!', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Dejected Young Man', 3: "That's right... I'll devour them. I'll devour every single person who looked down on me!", 4: '1'}
{3: "The young man's face twists grotesquely, his mouth wrenched into a rigid, manic grin."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong01.prefab'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong01.prefab'}

{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySugorokuScreen02.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'The black smoke surrounding him erupts violently. Tentacles burst forth, writhing and twisting like maddened life.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Get back! He's turning into a Nightmare!", 4: '18'}
{3: "As the young man's roar fades within the tide of black sludge, Kurumi's voice cuts through, clear and sharp."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryBlackSmokeNew.prefab', 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 3: 'She steps forward, placing herself between you and the threat. The muzzle of her flintlock glimmers with a cold, dim light, aimed precisely at the writhing mass as it warps into a chaotic shadow beyond recognition.'}
{2: "So the Nightmare we've been hunting down this whole time... was him?!", 3: '314'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'That certainly seems to be the case.', 4: '2'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'The victim being the culprit all along? Now that sounds like something right out of a cliched mystery fiction!', 4: '2', 18: '173064'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront17.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySugorokuScreen02.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiDuihualiziLoopRed.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab', 2: '2'}

{1: '1', 3: "Before she even finishes, the young man's head bursts open like a blooming Venus flytrap. Thick black sludge mixed with the crimson blood erupts and scatters in all directions. The shadows spawn from the muck one after another, lunging straight at you—exactly like what happened in the ballroom."}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory844.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.3'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront17.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory844.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiChongDongOpen.prefab', 2: '2', 5: '4'}

{3: 'A massive "door" emerges from the young man\'s ruined corpse, its frame blood-red. There, beyond the layered panels, murky shapes stir. More shadows yet writhe and converge within, their hunger for the living threatening to spill out.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong03.prefab'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong03.prefab'}
{1: '0', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong02.prefab'}

{1: '1', 3: "Among them, the young man's face flickers one last time. However, that expression is no longer human. It has been twisted into something caught between agony, relief, and insatiable hunger."}
{3: 'He glances at the two of you one last time, then turns and steps through the door, reuniting with his "companions."'}
{3: 'At this point, the answer you seek is practically in front of your faces—'}
{1: 'This young man was never devoured by a Nightmare all those days ago. He chose to become one.', 3: '40'}
{2: 'This young man was never devoured by a Nightmare all those days ago. He chose to become one.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiDuihualiziLoopRed.prefab'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiChongDongOpen.prefab', 5: '4'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiShizhong.prefab', 2: '1', 5: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: '<Zafkiel>!', 4: '15'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiShizhong.prefab', 5: '2'}
{3: "Zafkiel's hands spin. At the same time, Kurumi's speed surges. Her form splinters into afterimages of crimson and black, dashing through the oncoming onslaught of shadows, slashing them apart."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiMovie/FxUiMovieDao.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiMovie/FxUiMovieDao01.prefab', 2: '2'}

{3: "You follow close behind her. Whenever Kurumi reloads, or if there are gaps within the rain of bullets, you'd strike swiftly and precisely to cut down every Nightmare that manages to slip through."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiChongDongOpen.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: "However, the number of Nightmares beyond that crimson door is endless. They crawl forth from the Deep Dream without end, and the two of you alone won't be enough to stem the tide."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiChongDongOpen.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'These Nightmares are... much too persistent, just like parasites!', 4: '4'}

{3: "The black tide's assault continues to intensify. With each passing moment, your room to maneuver shrinks. Those shadows aren't exactly strong, but their numbers are overwhelming. On top of that, there's the putrid stench seeping through the door, as if the abyss itself lies beyond, bringing suffocating despair."}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Tch, I suppose we have no other choice.', 4: '4'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Human, we'll have to do what we did before. We'll retreat for now and find the Dream Master. She'll be able to help us close this door.", 4: '4'}
{2: "No, that won't solve anything. Nozomi told us her power had weakened after we closed that door last time.", 3: '393'}
{3: 'In the thick of battle, a bolder theory suddenly takes shape in your mind.'}
{2: "Just closing the door won't cut it. If we want to put an end to these Nightmares for good...", 3: '395'}
{2: "We'll have to bring him back from the other side of that door!", 3: '396'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'What?!', 4: '4'}
{3: 'Upon hearing your words, shock freezes Kurumi in place on the other side of the battlefield.'}
